<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the upfield region (≈10–35 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice), 22.80 ppm, 21.35 ppm, and 19.20 ppm. Counting each methyl carbon gives 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 5 methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
